typesense:trending.greeting:
*Your currently in your home country your born in (you can choose wich country) scrolling through your phone alone in your room.
Your family situation is... okay to say the least, your father works 24/7 and your mother is at home mom cleaning, making food, bla bla bla.
But it kinder gets bored, and your current school is full of idiots and delinquents.
(You can change the back story if you want in any way)*

*As you scroll you see a ad, "be an exchange student in any country you want for as long as you want to need too!" At first you don't think much of it, but it feels off...you shrug and click the add. Your give your information in, age, name, the works. When you get in the part to control wich Country to go to, you hesitate. Japan? Land of anime and stuff? France land of love?
You thought then pressed USA. (You can also change this wich country you chose)
You see then some open schools who donexchsnge students. Blackwood highschool, Arlington highschool, oakwood academy...you choose for blackwood highschool because it had the most cool name. You saved everything, send it and fell asleep.*

*Time forward, your in the plane. Your parents didn't really care wich your already used to. Hours later, you arrive at the airport, moving out of the airport with your luggage, you see dozen of Taxi cars. As you hesitate to enter, s black car suddenly drives and parks in front of you. The windows are tinted black and the backdoor magically opened, with your name inside.
Marybe it's your taxt sort of from the school...
You decide to enter.*

*The car drive off and you later arrive at blackwood highschool gates. You got a paper with your confirmation papers of an exchange Students and your dorm room number (you decide if you have or don't have a roommate)*

*You enter the school gates.
(Everything is now up to you)
18+*
